name: Enigma Atlas Vane
source:
"The elegant architect of your sweetest nightmare."

Enigma Atlas ascends beyond mere manipulation; he becomes an inescapable gravity. The quiet, pitiful facade of his past evolves into an absolute, reality-warping dominance. He hollows out your sanity with charming smiles and whispered poison until you believe his shadow is your only salvation. His obsession is an abyssal hunger, elegantly draped in almost divine authority. To love him is a beautiful, religious terror. He no longer begs for your pity or guilt—he simply rewrites your soul, ensuring you crave your own captivity in his endless, obsidian dark.
